搬家清理最容易卡住的，是把沙发、旧电脑和剩余油漆当成同一车垃圾。先写物品清单，再: A move-out clearout gets complicated when a sofa, old computer and leftover paint are treated as one load. List the items, then find each service. County household hazardous waste programs and city bulky pickup are separate things, and a neighbor's included pickups may not apply to your account.
先分三类，再预约搬运: Sort into three categories before booking transport
家具与床垫：先找垃圾账单上的清运商，问清租客能不能直接预约、件数、费用和摆放时段: Furniture and mattresses: ask the hauler on your trash bill whether tenants can book directly, and about item limits, fees and set-out times; keep items off the curb until they answer.
电脑与电子设备：按具体物品查电子回收清单；小电器、电视、电池的去处可能不同，普通: Computers and electronics: check the exact item on the accepted list. Small appliances, televisions and batteries may each go somewhere different; ordinary recycling-bin rules don't apply.
油漆、清洁剂等家庭危险废物：先查接受范围。标签不明、泄漏或损坏的物品先联系项目人: Paint, cleaners and other household hazardous waste: check acceptance first. Contact program staff about unknown labels, leaks or damaged items and obtain guidance before arranging drop-off.
按居住地区找官方入口: Find official services for your home area
旧金山：Recology 大件项目按有效住宅账户及住房类型核资格；危险废物另走: San Francisco: Recology bulky pickup eligibility depends on an active residential account and housing type. Hazardous waste uses a separate HHW service.
半岛：San Mateo County HHW 先预约；家具上门仍问所在城市的清: Peninsula: book San Mateo County HHW in advance. Ask your city's hauler about furniture pickup.
南湾：Santa Clara County HHW 要预约，并会查居住证明；Pa: South Bay: Santa Clara County HHW requires an appointment and checks residency. Palo Alto residents use the city program.
东湾：Alameda County 居民从 StopWaste 查设施；常设点无: East Bay: Alameda County residents can find facilities through StopWaste. Permanent facilities do not require appointments, but check opening dates and accepted items. Other counties have their own programs.
北湾：Marin 从 Marin HHW 查起，Novato 另查本地设施；Ma: North Bay: start with Marin HHW, while Novato has its own facility. Marin eligibility does not extend to Sonoma or Napa.
拍清物品外观、记下数量和大致尺寸，先询问接受范围与收费。县居民项目通常针对自己家: Photograph items and note quantities and approximate dimensions, then ask about acceptance and fees. Resident programs generally cover waste from your own household; business, contractor and collected waste need separate checks. Some drop-off addresses are given only after you book, so navigate by the booking reply. Don't rely on an old map, and one disposal fee doesn't cover every item.
查清城市、县与清运商的服务范围。: Check the city, county and hauler service area.
逐项对照接受清单、数量限制和费用。: Go item by item through accepted items, quantity limits and fees.
保存预约及官方要求的居住证明说明。: Save booking details and the official residency-proof requirements.
和物业约好搬运、摆放及通道安排。: Arrange moving, set-out locations and access with property management.
